definitions.explanation: Relating to or occurring once a year. Used as a prefix or modifier in formal and business contexts.
The number of years one has been in a position, organization, or academic program.

examples.japanese: {年次|ねんじ}{報告書|ほうこくしょ}を{作成|さくせい}する。
{年次|ねんじ}{有給|ゆうきゅう}{休暇|きゅうか}は{二十日|はつか}ある。
examples.english: I have twenty days of annual paid leave.

examples.japanese: {年次|ねんじ}{大会|たいかい}が{来月|らいげつ}{開催|かいさい}される{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: The annual convention is scheduled to be held next month.

examples.japanese: {年次|ねんじ}の{高|たか}い{社員|しゃいん}が{多|おお}い。
{年次|ねんじ}に{関係|かんけい}なく{実力|じつりょく}で{評価|ひょうか}する。
examples.english: We evaluate based on ability regardless of seniority.

examples.japanese: {入社|にゅうしゃ}{年次|ねんじ}が{同|おな}じ{同期|どうき}と{久|ひさ}しぶりに{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I met up with colleagues from the same year of hiring after a long time.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is very common in business Japanese, especially in compounds like {年次|ねんじ}{報告|ほうこく} and {年次|ねんじ}{休暇|きゅうか}. Sense 2 is used in workplace and academic contexts to indicate how many years someone has been at an institution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年次|ねんじ}{報告|ほうこく} (annual report)
- {年次|ねんじ}{有給|ゆうきゅう}{休暇|きゅうか} (annual paid leave)
- {年次|ねんじ}{大会|たいかい} (annual convention)
- {入社|にゅうしゃ}{年次|ねんじ} (year of hiring)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年間|ねんかん}: over the course of a year
- {毎年|まいとし}: every year (more everyday)
